clues.value: Serena is involved again. This time, Drarin takes her to the honeymoon spot where he and ▇▇▇ went. ▇▇▇ is at a Witches Council meeting and doesn't know what is going on. ▇▇▇ gets intimate with Serena, thinking that she is ▇▇▇, and she tells him to back off. Then ▇▇▇ is called to solve the puzzle.
